pages.text: Silver and Cold Iron Arrows work with bows, crossbows and dispensers. The picked-up arrow retains its material. Infinity does not grant unlimited metal arrows.

A matching nugget, a wooden stick and a Raven's Feather make four arrows. Ravens now supply feathers through shedding, Boline collection and drops. Material-weak targets receive a separate magic-damage attempt: 1.5 for creatures or 2.25 for weakness-tagged players. Ordinary hurt immunity can suppress this extra hit.
